messages:
oliver: Heads-up: running partition migration for account_events tonight 01:30 UTC. This moves month partitions and adds fk constraint. Estimated 2h. Requesting deploybot pin to schema-v3.0.1 and disable canary in eu-west-1. Any objections?
tara: Ack. What's the partition range and downtime expectations?
oliver: Range: 2023-01 -> 2025-12. No full downtime intended; we will lock individual partition briefly during attach/detach. We'll run with parallelism=1 and pause between partitions (pause_ms=30000).
kevin: Suggest abort criteria: sustained p95 DB latency >250ms for 5m OR more than 3 exclusive lock waits >2m. Also if replica lag >60s.
oliver: Agreed. Adding replica lag >60s to abort triggers.
kevin: Preparing backout snippet and quick rollback commands now.
kevin: ```sql
-- backout: stop migrations and revert partition pointers
UPDATE backfill_control SET state='aborted' WHERE run_id=%%RUN_ID%%;
-- re-enable old partition attachment if needed
ALTER TABLE account_events ATTACH PARTITION account_events_p2025_12 FOR VALUES FROM ('2025-12-01') TO ('2026-01-01');
```

tara: If deploybot can't pin, manual fallback is to gate the migration behind feature flag 'ae_partition_migrate' and set to false. @kevin will you own manual unpin?
kevin: I can manual-unpin and toggle the flag. I'll be on pager.
deploybot: schedule accepted. Pinning schema-v3.0.1 for release-group 'account-events-migration' at 1769901234. Canary disabled in eu-west-1. Will emit events to #eng-releases and this thread. Alerts: p95>200ms or replica_lag>45s.
infra-bot: Added draft release note at release_notes/1769901234.md: "Partition migration for account_events (2023-01 -> 2025-12). Short exclusive locks during partition detach/attach; possible brief query spikes. Abort criteria and rollback runbook attached in thread."
oliver: Will run a single test partition at 01:30 (p2023_06). If that succeeds for 10m health checks, proceed with the rest sequentially.
kevin: Rollback runbook (commands to execute if abort):
```bash
# stop the migration job
curl -X POST "https://deploy.internal/api/migrations/%%RUN_ID%%/abort" -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN"
# flip feature flag
psql -c "UPDATE feature_flags SET enabled=false WHERE name='ae_partition_migrate';"
# reattach previous partition if needed (example)
psql -c "ALTER TABLE account_events ATTACH PARTITION account_events_p2023_06 FOR VALUES FROM ('2023-06-01') TO ('2023-07-01');"
# notify channel and ops
"""
Send: @oncall: migration aborted due to thresholds. Manual follow-up required.
"""
```

tara: I'll watch the health dashboard and DB p95. Kevin will be ready to unpin. Oliver will run the test partition and report back in 15m intervals.
kevin: Also note: deploybot will log pin metadata. If we need to unpin, run: `deployctl pin --release-group account-events-migration --unpin`
oliver: Test partition queued for 01:30 UTC. Starting at +5m after window open to allow deploybot to reconcile. Will post progress updates.
deploybot: test partition run started for p2023_06. Progress updates every 10m.
infra-bot: Added check: smoke test script `scripts/smoke_account_events.sh` will run after each partition; it returns non-zero on failure and flags the thread.
kevin: Good. One more thing: add a temporary 2m read-only soft-quiesce for heavy analytic jobs to reduce noise during attach. I’ll coordinate with data-platform.
oliver: Done. Scheduling soft-quiesce from 01:25 -> 04:00 UTC.
tara: On call and monitoring. Will DM if abort criteria met.
kevin: Ready for manual unpin if required.
oliver: Thanks team — will update in 10m after test partition completes.
